input: Set up a home network printer for the office

gold.taskTitle: Set Up a Home Network Printer for the Office
gold.taskDescription: Set up a printer on the home network so it is accessible for office use.

questions.title: Which printer brand and model are you setting up?
questions.description: Identify the exact printer make and model to tailor setup instructions.

questions.title: Does the printer connect via Wi-Fi, Ethernet, or USB?
questions.description: Determine the connection type the printer will use to join the network.

questions.title: How many computers or devices need to access it?
questions.description: Understand the scale of the setup to ensure all devices are configured.

questions.title: What operating systems are the office computers running?
questions.description: Identify whether the computers run Windows, macOS, Linux, or a mix, as driver installation varies.

questions.title: Is the printer brand new or previously used elsewhere?
questions.description: Determine if the printer needs a full first-time setup or a reconfiguration from a prior network.

questions.title: Do you have the printer's driver software or installation disc?
questions.description: Check whether drivers are already available or need to be downloaded.

questions.title: Should any device have priority or admin control over the printer?
questions.description: Clarify whether one computer should act as the host or if all devices need equal peer-to-peer access.
